title: Maintaining Correct Pipe Slope to Prevent Waste Stagnation
description: Maintaining accurate pitch on horizontal drainage piping is critical for effective waste removal. Gravity drainage relies on balanced flow velocity where water carries solid waste together through the pipe. If pipe slope is insufficient or sagging occurs due to loose hangers, standing water accumulates and solids settle, leading to chronic blockages. Over-sloping can also cause liquids to run clear of solids in certain pipe configurations. Routine maintenance includes verifying pipe alignment and inspecting support hanger spacing according to local code requirements to preserve self-scouring flow along the entire line.

Over-sloping can also cause liquids to run clear of solids in certain pipe configurations. Routine maintenance includes verifying pipe alignment and inspecting support hanger spacing according to local code requirements to preserve self-scouring flow along the entire line.
